rationale: Master ČNB legislative hub covering banking and payments rule bases — the primary A3 crawl root for CZ.
Banking rule register is a child section of the legislativní základna hub already monitored as c_001.
Payments (PI/EMI) rule register is a child of the same hub; equal-weight payments scope, covered by parent crawl.
Věstník ČNB is the authentic gazette with its own dated částky series — standalone deadline spine.
Supervisory benchmarks and úřední sdělení: unique soft-law stream published nowhere else.
RS interpretative opinions form their own numbered, continuously produced series on banking/payments law.
Consultation/draft-vyhláška register gives 3-12 months lead time on binding CZ rules — core A3 deadline signal.
ESA comply-or-explain notices sit under the legislativní základna hub; valuable but reachable via parent.
ČNB consultation responses are a hub sub-section; directional colour only, no standalone monitoring need.
Static description of payments supervisory mandate; context page within the supervision chapter, rarely changes.
Static credit-institution supervision mandate page; background context under the supervision chapter.
Supervision news feed is the cheapest continuous change watchpoint across the whole ČNB supervision chapter.
RSS index is the machine-readable ingestion layer for ČNB updates; low-fragility monitoring path.
Daily-updated enforcement decision register showing which control failures ČNB actually sanctions.
Statutory annual supervision reports on a fixed 30 June calendar, stating the coming regulatory agenda.
SDAT methodology changelog is the most deadline-dense, operationally binding reporting stream for banks/PSPs.
Statistical-reporting vyhlášky sit outside the supervision chapter and would be missed by a supervision-only crawl.
Payments-operations legal list duplicates the payments rule base; useful cross-check under the cnb.cz parent.
CCyB opatření obecné povahy series carries forward-dated application dates binding on bank capital planning.
Bank Board macroprudential decisions are the upstream decision layer giving short lead on binding buffers.
EN mirror of the Czech legislation hub; useful for terminology but redundant with the cs parent.
Disclosure-duty link registers mine once into an actor list of CZ banks/credit unions with disclosure endpoints.
Licensing procedure guidance for PI/EMI is a stable sub-page of the supervision chapter; legacy URL pattern.
Event calendar pre-announces publication and decision dates — backbone of a regulatory-deadline watch.
Pre-2006 Securities Commission archive: historical, securities-focused, minimal forward A3 value.
Downloadable XLS harmonogram of ČNB publication dates — machine-readable annual timetable for the calendar.
